description: The pie chart visually represents the time distribution between two key components of the Paper Copilot system: “Reduction” and “Efficient deployment.” The chart is divided into two segments, with the larger segment, colored in a dark brownish-orange, labeled “Reduction” and accounting for 69.92% of the total time (60.9 seconds). The smaller segment, in a muted teal-blue, is labeled “Efficient deployment” and represents 30.08% of the time (26.2 seconds). The “Efficient deployment” slice is slightly exploded outward from the center, drawing visual attention to it. Both slices include their respective time values and percentage contributions directly within the chart, without requiring a separate legend. The overall presentation suggests that the majority of processing time is consumed by the reduction phase, while efficient deployment constitutes a smaller but significant portion of the system’s runtime.
